top_choice_rationale: P007 recognizes a mature and consequential political-economy reorientation linking political institutions, state capacity, and fiscal choices to development. Besley, Persson, and Tabellini have complementary and identifiable contributions to this bounded achievement, whose theoretical and comparative relevance has consolidated over time.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile. Stockholm University collegial relationships with committee members do not concern the proposed laureates.
